newsitem.title: USA: Rocky Shoes sees '97 sales rising 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rocky Shoes sees '97 sales rising 30 pct.

text.p: Rocky Shoes & Boots Inc predicted on Tuesday that 1997 sales would be 30 percent above last year's, accompanied by a similar increase in earings.
"The company achieved record net sales of $73.2 million and record net income of $2,805,959, or $0.74 per share, in 1996," said Mike Brooks, chairman and chief executive of the footwear manufacturer.

Based on a backlog of branded footwear products and forecasts of future orders, he added, "we now anticipate that 1997 sales will be 30 percent above last year's, with a similar increase in earnings."
